prompt: Turn this sketch into a photorealistic industrial-design studio render of a palm-sized handheld camera, same 3/4 front view, proportions and composition as the sketch. Concept: light meeting a black hole. Core body: matte black, light-absorbing paint. Over it, soft inflated light-grey tubes in satin soft-touch finish: they form a rounded hand grip on the left, run up over the top, twist and cross each other in a loose braid between the two top blocks, and one tube curves down and wraps fully around the lens as a thick continuous torus, a satin light-grey photon ring. The ring is solid painted material: no LED, no glow, no emitted light. Lens: inside the ring the black body funnels inward like a smooth event-horizon cone, and at the bottom sits a real recessed camera lens about 35 mm in diameter: black anodized barrel with fine knurling, dark coated glass front element with subtle concentric reflections of inner elements and a faint purple-green coating sheen. Details: dark rectangular viewfinder block top rear left; dark cylindrical dial block top right with knurled black cap; round black domed shutter button on top of the grip; small USB-C port visible on the left outer side face of the grip in a black inset panel. Crisp continuous surfaces, clean part lines, reads as a 3D-printed and painted design model. One single camera fully in frame, centered, seamless pure white background, large softbox key light from upper left, soft contact shadow, high-end product photography, sharp focus. No text, no logos, no watermark, no glowing ring, no extra objects, no hands.
